record.field: Sent when a customer requests a one-time code to identify themselves in self-order.

table.style: width:480px; max-width:100%; background:#ffffff; border:1px solid #e7e5e4; border-radius:6px;

td.style: padding:32px 32px 0 32px; font-family:-apple-system,'Segoe UI',Roboto,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif; font-size:15px; line-height:22px; color:#1c1917;

div.style: font-family:'SFMono-Regular',Consolas,'Liberation Mono',Menlo,monospace; font-size:34px; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:9px; color:#1c1917; padding:16px 8px 16px 17px; background:#fafaf9; border:1px solid #e7e5e4; border-radius:4px;

td.style: padding:0 32px 32px 32px; font-family:-apple-system,'Segoe UI',Roboto,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif; font-size:15px; line-height:22px; color:#1c1917;
td.p: It expires in 10 minutes and can be used once.

p.style: margin:0; padding-top:20px; border-top:1px solid #e7e5e4; font-size:13px; line-height:20px; color:#78716c;

td.p: If you didn't ask for a code, you can ignore this message. Nobody can use it without your mailbox.

td.style: padding:16px 8px 0 8px; font-family:-apple-system,'Segoe UI',Roboto,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif; font-size:12px; line-height:18px; color:#a8a29e;
